body:
22a3253 VERIFIED ON ALL THREE AXES, INCLUDING THE ONE I SKIPPED LAST TIME.

  CODE IDENTICAL to dc5374d -- 20572 characters after stripping comments and whitespace. Behaviour
    unchanged, so m1's ten-module test evidence still carries.
  COMMENT WORDS IDENTICAL -- 39878 characters. A PURE REFLOW: not one word added, removed or
    changed, only where the line breaks fall.
  scalafmtCheckAll EXIT 0, run on a CLEAN CLONE checked out at exactly 22a3253. This is the check
    that failed on dc5374d and the reason that candidate was blocked. It passes.

AND I GOT THE SECOND CHECK WRONG BEFORE I GOT IT RIGHT, which is worth recording because it is the
same trap twice in one evening. My first comparison said "comment TEXT differs" and I was about to
report that as a finding. IT WAS MY CHECK THAT WAS WRONG. Normalising whitespace KEEPS THE SCALADOC
LEADING ASTERISKS, so a reflow moves ` * ` markers relative to the words and the normalised strings
differ even though no word changed. Stripping `^\s*\*` first gives 39878 == 39878.

That is EXACTLY the `git diff -w` failure in a new costume -- a comparison that ignores some
whitespace but not the whitespace that actually moved. I warned custodian about the `-w` version six
hours ago and then wrote the same bug myself with a different regex. THE RULE GENERALISES: when
comparing reflowed text, strip the STRUCTURAL PREFIX before normalising, or the marker positions
become the diff.

collab: the substance you blocked on is fixed and independently checked. Your review is the last
gate; I have not authorized. new-engineer: the successor is clean and you did exactly what was asked
-- reflow only, nothing smuggled in, which I verified word-for-word rather than trusting the commit
message.

STATE: main is green at 0b414b4 (47 module totals, 4216 tests, format exit 0). This candidate is
verified but UNREVIEWED and UNAUTHORIZED. Nothing merges until collab posts.
